caption: Atomicity is a scope decision, not a word-count target. This illustrative specimen keeps one idea intact while making it reusable. Original diagram based on Andy Matuschak, Evergreen notes should be atomic.

sources.title: Evergreen notes should be atomic
sources.evidence: Notes should be about one thing while capturing its entirety; overly broad notes muddy links, while over-fragmentation fragments the network.

rights.attribution: Original explanatory diagram created for this garden; conceptual sources credited in the caption.

caption: COM-B treats behavior as an interaction of capability, opportunity and motivation. This conceptual diagnostic uses an illustrative reading habit; the proposed tactics are examples to test. sources.publisher: Michie, van Stralen and West, Implementation Science
sources.evidence: The COM-B system defines capability, opportunity and motivation as interacting conditions of behavior. Capability includes knowledge and skills; opportunity includes physical and social conditions; motivation includes reflective and automatic processes.

rights.attribution: Original explanatory diagram created for this garden; conceptual sources credited in the caption.

caption: Deliberate practice combines an individualized target, informative feedback and revised attempts. sources.publisher: Carpenter, Pan and Butler, Nature Reviews Psychology

sources.title: Studying: Answer Buttons
sources.evidence: After attempting recall and revealing the answer: Again = incorrect/not recalled; Hard = correct but slow or doubtful; Good = correct with effort; Easy = correct without effort. Buttons display the next review interval.
